2023_014_aug_2023_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) report for August 2023, printed 10/12/2023 and presented to the Board of Education on October 17, 2023, itemizes every district PCARD transaction by transaction description, journal-entry description ("AUG PCARD EXP"), budget unit, account code, transaction amount and credits across 30 pages. The report closes with a Subtotal of 302,371.28 in transaction amounts against 4,521.71 in credits, and Total Expenses of 297,849.57. The single largest charge is 13,860.00 to IB SOURCE on 8/4/2023, posted to budget unit 101074113007400, account 5210.

**Document type and period**
Purchasing-card (PCARD) activity report for TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT covering August 2023, printed 10/12/2023 and appearing on the Board of Education agenda for the meeting of October 17, 2023. Every page carries the header "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, August 2023" and the columns Transaction Description / JE Description / Budget Unit / A/C Code / Transaction Amount / Credits. **Funds represented by budget-unit prefix**
General fund units beginning 101 dominate (building instructional supplies at account 5110, office supplies at 5910, other supplies at 5990). Grant/categorical units beginning 120 and 122 appear (for example 120210132736000 for ARTICULATE G at 1,399.00 and COMPTIA at 2,384.00; 122885221326000 for GRAND TRAV R lodging). Student activity and athletic units beginning 700 and 701 carry account code 5000. Adult education units 529202... record MICHIGAN WOR at 2,250.00 on 7/26/2023, GOTOCOM*GOTO at 2,280.00, JEWISH VOCAT at 1,350.00 and ZOOM.US at 749.50. Early childhood units 531004/531007/531010/531014 record HIGHSCOPE ED, LAKESHORE LE and two AMZN MKTP US equipment charges of 1,409.97 each on 7/27/2023 at account 6410. Community/aquatics unit 530212351021200 records TROY GRAND D at 966.00 and 845.94. Capital unit 423160225000000 records APPLE.COM/US purchases of 238.00, 229.95 and 199.95 at account 6410.

**Credits**
Credits offset charges throughout, including OU MP DS PAC 725.00 (101425221042600), multiple AMZN MKTP US credits of 136.51 across 122... units, AMZN MKTP US 247.98 (101902261849900), AMAZON.COM 260.00 (101005111100100), CRYSTAL MTN 215.42 (101902283021500), KIWICO INC. 93.65, CUSTOMINK LL 47.51, TRU BY HILTO 41.76 and six STAPLES credits of 8.53.

**Recurring themes**
Back-to-school supply buying (Amazon, Staples, Scholastic, Lakeshore, School Specialty, REI*GREENWOO), menstrual-product purchases from AUNT FLOW at 1,680.00 each in four separate secondary-building units, association dues and conference travel (MASB 2,653.00; MSBO; MIAAA; MACAE; MDE EDUCATOR licensing fees), and eleven DELTA charges on 8/24/2023 in unit 101425221042600.
